query:
-- 統計異常低價 PSA10 記錄（JPY < 5000 或 HKD < 300）
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_anomalies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN jpyPrice IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_jpyprice,
  SUM(CASE WHEN jpyPrice < 5000 AND jpyPrice IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as very_low_jpy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(price AS DECIMAL) < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as low_hkd
FROM priceHistory
WHERE grade IN ('PSA10', 'PSA 10')
  AND (jpyPrice IS NULL OR jpyPrice < 5000 OR CAST(price AS DECIMAL) < 300);
